description: This file contains a test suite for GatewayChannelRequest functionality, specifically testing request timeout and failure handling in a WebSocket gateway context.

classes.name: GatewayChannelRequestTests
classes.description: A struct defining test cases for gateway channel request behaviors, using async/await and mocking WebSocket sessions.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket session with a specified send delay, used to simulate network conditions during tests.

methods.name: request timeout then send failure does not double resume
methods.description: A test method verifying that after a request times out, a subsequent send failure does not cause errors such as double resumption of continuations.
